SPECIALTY CONSULTATION NOTE
Patient: Arthur Pendelton | DOB: 11/23/1954 | DOS: 01/20/2026
Consulting Specialist: Dr. Evelyn Zhao, MD (Endocrinology & Metabolism, NPI: 1049281745)
Requesting Physician: Dr. Robert Miller, MD (PCP, Internal Medicine, NPI: 1938472910)
Facility: Valley Health Endocrinology Specialists

REASON FOR CONSULTATION:
Formal written referral received on 01/15/2026 from PCP Dr. Robert Miller requesting specialized endocrine opinion and management recommendations for brittle glycemic control (HbA1c 10.4% despite dual oral hypoglycemic therapy) and symptomatic diabetic polyneuropathy.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
71-year-old male with poorly controlled Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (ICD-10: E11.9) referred for expert evaluation. Reports recurrent fasting hyperglycemias (220-280 mg/dL) and painful distal bilateral lower extremity paresthesias.

COMPREHENSIVE EXAMINATION & COUNSELING (Total face-to-face duration: 62 minutes):
- Comprehensive review of home glucose logs, nutritional habits, and medication adherence.
- Neurological exam: Reduced vibration sensation bilaterally via 128Hz tuning fork, absent Achilles reflexes bilaterally.
- Foot exam: Monofilament testing abnormal at 4/10 sites bilaterally, skin intact, pedal pulses 2+.

ASSESSMENT & PLAN:
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with uncontrolled hyperglycemia (ICD-10: E11.69 / E11.9).
2. Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (ICD-10: E11.40).
3. Initiated basal insulin glargine 14 units nightly; titrated metformin to 1000 mg BID.
4. Prescribed continuous glucose monitor (Dexcom G7) and referred for diabetic self-management education.

WRITTEN CONSULTATION REPORT STATUS:
A full formal 4-page written consultation report detailing diagnostic findings and therapeutic recommendations was transmitted via secure EHR direct messaging to requesting provider Dr. Robert Miller on 01/20/2026 at 16:30 EST.

Signed: Evelyn Zhao, MD, Endocrinology (01/20/2026 16:45 EST)
